envelope.description: Ensure the merge rules and the journal ignore entry

body.title: Ensure the merge rules and the journal ignore entry
body.summary: Add the idempotent ensure step that adds the two merge=union rules from mergeAttributes to the repository's .gitattributes and the .insrc/journal/ entry to its ignore file, adding only missing lines and logging a warning when a file cannot be written; call it when the file sidecar store is created; commit the two files for this repository.
acceptanceChecks: a repository with no .gitattributes gets the two rules, one with other rules keeps them and gains only the missing lines, and a second call writes nothing
an unwritable file is a warning and the store still works
this repository's .gitattributes and .gitignore carry the new lines

tests.name: sidecar-files.test.ts: the ensure step adds only the missing lines to .gitattributes and .gitignore, is idempotent, and an unwritable file is a warning
